findings_and_questions.first_contract: Current public MeleeLunge forward/quickstep variants contain raw f32 distance. In melee_lunge_arrival the Forward case returns ArrivesIn for distance <=0 before checking !is_finite; a direct Forward(-infinity) therefore takes the nonpositive path instead of the later nonfinite error. Quickstep arrival uses duration and does not examine its distance field. The P16-labeled archived variant used checked finite SignedLength leaves, but no P16 snapshot-head claim or automatic current historical repair is implied.
findings_and_questions.conditions_and_safeguards: The bounded actual client passes melee_lunge output to arrival; server plans movement via melee_lunge and remaps its nonnegative gap into the enum. The function checks separation and maximum travel for finiteness and uses max(0) for gap. These selected producers do not establish a -infinity payload. Direct external construction is syntactically possible but supported callers, API policy, actuation and gameplay consequences remain unproved. Negative or zero finite distances and unassisted/cannot-arrive outcomes have explicit meanings and must not be silently removed.

findings_and_questions.future_repair_direction: After audit completion and implementation authorization, choose one admitted distance owner and check any direct variant construction before early-return or movement retention, preserving the selected finite/zero/non-arrival timing and server authority. Trace all actual client/server/native producers and callers before deciding policy.

thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: Current lunge variant distance and authority scheduled measure are raw f32; actual client/server planners, admission and current typed retained endpoints need shared ownership. Archived p16 used SignedLength but its unknown snapshot and valid behavior constraints matter.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: SignedLength owns finite signed metres; UnitInterval owns finite [0,1] performance; AnimationElapsed owns finite nonnegative time; ReportedPrecision intentionally accepts all finite values, not a probability.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: ReportedPrecision checks finite only; direct public MeleeLunge variants carry unchecked floats and Forward checks nonfinite after the nonpositive branch. Recovery and fraction owners guard their own outputs; other ingress contracts remain open.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: Positive recovery divided by a positive finite performance can overflow and explicitly returns timing error; zero base and zero performance have distinct intentional branches. Finite checked primitive operations do not prove caller reachability or whole-domain safety.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: Private melee windup and active options are created/cleared together in selected operations; production expect is already tracked, but no supported None-state panic is proved. Combat total aggregates impairment sources and requires provenance and UI reconciliation.
thirteen_lenses.type-ownership: Shared core owns recovery/fraction semantics, tactical core owns lunge/arrival, server owns authoritative facts; transient tactical health, positions and enemies must remain in server authority.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: Selected condition update sums fatigue and encumbrance once alongside other sources; displaying projected increase is separately derived. This bounded view does not rule out duplicate penalties or conflicting writers in uninspected systems.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: Preserve intentional unclamped finite precision, negative/zero finite unassisted lunge behavior, ordinary attacks on CannotArrive, zero recovery, independent limb injuries and total-wheel combat performance; no historical snapshot restores or compatibility shims inferred.
thirteen_lenses.enum-shapes: MeleeLungeArrival and RecoveryTime keep meaningful distinct outcomes; Option is used only at selected wire/lookup boundary. Current MeleeLunge raw payload admission remains a separate question.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: RecoveryTime Serialize maps its enum to Option at the native boundary; preserve its distinction while checking consumers. No blanket derive recommendation or macro execution inferred.
thirteen_lenses.granularity: Distinguish scene position versus signed distance, reach/closure versus positive-duration and unit interval, authored speed versus reported precision, and requested movement from authoritative outcome. Same numeric storage does not make their owners interchangeable.
thirteen_lenses.magic-strings: Reciprocal StreamId is a deterministic named stream; lunge planned log outcomes are diagnostics and their consumer contract is uninspected. No private business protocol defect follows from these strings alone.
thirteen_lenses.magic-numbers: Recovery clamping and 0/1 thresholds belong to existing combat rule; constant lunge epsilon and offhand retention need their actual configured-policy/AGENTS ownership reconciled, not speculative replacement. No hidden fatigue or movement penalty should be introduced.

limitations: Evidence restoration, static source inspection, source mathematical reasoning and offline integrity verification only. No source/publication edits, repairs, product builds/tests, runtime probes, gameplay, fixture execution or simulation.
